pointQr.title: QR code
pointQr.hint: Download a point image, download all QR codes as ZIP, or print to PDF. QR codes only identify points; sign-in and task permissions are still required.
pointQr.limit: More than 500 points match. Narrow the filters before printing.

pointImport.title: Import point workbook
pointImport.hint: This import belongs to the project shown above. Close and reopen to change projects. Fill all four columns: category ID, category name, point name and location. The reference sheet lists this project's category names, paths and IDs. XLS/XLSX, up to 1000 rows and 10MB. Categories must be enabled and belong to this project. Existing points with the same category, name and location cannot be imported again. All rows must pass before insertion; existing points are not overwritten and roles are not assigned automatically.
pointImport.summary: {total} rows: {valid} valid, {errors} with errors, {categories} categories in valid rows. No rows are imported while errors remain.
pointImport.fileInvalid: Choose an XLS or XLSX file no larger than 10MB
pointImport.failed: Validation or import failed. Correct the errors and select the file again.

Patrol.title: Patrol
Patrol.name: Name
Patrol.categoryDepthHint: Categories support up to three levels. Level three cannot have children.
Patrol.rosterOptional: Allow without roster; otherwise enforce shift
Patrol.ruleHint: One task per configured period; count complete frequency cycles. Earlier end times cross midnight, equal times mean 24 hours. Date rules override weekday rules.
Patrol.snapshotHint: Preview does not save tasks. Generated tasks retain snapshots and are not overwritten by plan edits.
Patrol.reportHint: Based on task business dates, up to 31 days. Only accepted executions count; applications and exemptions are excluded.
Patrol.saveFailed: Not saved. Correct the input or retry.
Patrol.referenceHint: Reference notes are for inspection guidance; text equality does not imply a pass.
Patrol.firstOptionHint: The first option is normal; other answers are shown in red.
Patrol.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5MB per image.
Patrol.itemTitleRequired: Enter an item title (up to 200 characters)
Patrol.invalidOptions: Options must be unique; passing options must belong to the available options
Patrol.invalidLimits: Use up to 18 integer and 6 decimal digits; lower limit must not exceed upper limit
Patrol.levelRuleHint: Use the selected point level rule. Custom rules remain available for existing plans without a level.

calendar.pointProgressValue: {completed} completed points out of {expected} expected points
calendar.pointHint: A point is completed only when all roles finish all tasks for the day. Patrolled points with overdue unfinished tasks count as missed. Points with no valid patrols after all periods end count as absent. These counts do not overlap. Expand a point to view role execution details.
calendar.monthlyPointHint: Monthly totals sum daily point counts. The same point is counted separately for each day.

statistics.hint: Filter by task creation date. Coverage = completed / expected patrols. Qualification = completed / total task periods, separate from inspection results.
statistics.peopleHint: Aggregate expected and completed patrols by the original appointed subject. Role assignments show the role; shared counts are not split by actual executor.

Patrol.replaceRosterConfirm: Replace all rosters for {month} in this application?
Patrol.imported: Imported {count} rosters. View them in the calendar.
Patrol.rosterTemplateHint: Select a project and download the monthly template of accessible active employees. Role is optional. Define shifts, then enter a shift or Rest from row 6. Staff IDs identify employees; names are for display. Import replaces the selected project’s monthly schedule.

ruleEditor.weekHint: Each weekday belongs to one rule; periods must not overlap
ruleEditor.dateHint: This date uses this rule instead of its weekday rule
ruleEditor.addDate: Add date (configure a rule for a specific date)

errors.empty: Configure at least one weekday rule or date rule
errors.days: Select at least one weekday for rule {index}
errors.periods: Add at least one period to rule {index}
errors.number: Frequency, count and interval must be integers from 1 to 100
errors.capacity: A period must not exceed 10000 patrols and must accommodate its frequency and minimum interval
errors.duplicateDay: A weekday can belong to only one rule
errors.date: Select a valid date for every date rule
errors.datePeriods: Add at least one period for {date}
errors.overlap: Patrol periods overlap; check overnight periods on the previous day too
errors.limit: At most 24 periods per rule and 366 date rules are allowed

Patrol.warningSettingsHint: Configure abnormal triggers, warning codes and display colors.
Patrol.selectCategory: Select a category on the left

missed.title: Missed inspections
missed.reasonRequired: Enter a reason or rejection note, up to 500 characters
missed.approveHint: Approval credits the selected missed occurrences and preserves the review record.
missed.loadFailed: Could not load missed inspections. Retry.
missed.empty: No missed occurrences in this range
missed.range: Select a range of up to 31 days
missed.actionFailed: The action failed. Refresh and retry.

Patrol.assignmentRulePair: Select both a level and a standard, or clear both fields
Patrol.assignmentBatchHelp: Saving applies these roles and rules to all selected points. The first point’s configuration is shown.
Patrol.assignmentPostsHelp: Configure role rules and/or all-staff patrol. Role tasks check role membership and any project schedule for the day; all-staff tasks do not require a role or shift. Level and standard must be supplied together to generate tasks.
Patrol.assignmentLimit: Select at most 100 points and 20 roles per operation

configDelete.confirm: Delete this configuration? Referenced point-role rules must be updated first.
configDelete.failed: Deletion failed. Check the error and try again.

Patrol.creator: Created by

pointCategories.linkHelp: Link these points to another category while keeping existing categories and patrol records.
pointCategories.cancelHelp: Remove only the selected category association and its role rules. Keep the physical points and historical patrol records.
pointCategories.noCommon: These points have no category in common. Select points from the same category.
pointCategories.choose: Select the category for this operation.

projects.label: Project
projects.failed: Unable to load projects. Please retry.
projects.migrationHint: Only records without a project, including legacy organization-owned configuration, can be assigned. Review the target project first. Assign attachments, categories, standards, levels and roles before points, rosters and plans; assign parent categories first.

Patrol.codeKeepExisting: Leave blank to keep the existing code

overview.title: Patrol fulfillment
overview.scopeHint: Generated tasks by business date. Select a count to inspect its details.
overview.notDueHint: Remaining visits in open or future periods
overview.pointHint: One task per project, point and business date. Every role and period must be fulfilled. Missed means some completion with overdue requirements; absent means no effective completion after all periods ended. Check anomalies are independent.
overview.peopleHint: Actual visits for tasks belonging to the selected business dates. Shared role requirements are not assigned to individual members. No personal completion rate or ranking.
overview.drillHint: Details group by project, point and business date. Values update with visits and reviews.
overview.noExecutions: No actual visits. Approved credits do not create execution facts.
overview.progressRateHint: Effective completions / all required visits. Includes approved credits and requirements in open periods.
overview.dueFulfillmentRateHint: Effective completions in ended periods / requirements in ended periods. Open periods are excluded. Includes approved credits; this is not an on-time check-in rate.
overview.noDue: No required visits in ended periods

recordExport.detail_limit: More than 100000 related details. Narrow the filters or export in batches.
